# Guarded build 2246 publisher

This controller derives from the production baseline and contains only eight allowlisted publishing paths. Never merge it into main. Keep the application candidate/tree unchanged. No preliminary workflow merge or production deployment is needed to make the existing authorized Actions publisher available.

Reuse the established actor/ref-bound GITHUB_TOKEN with contents:write for prepare -> expected-head application PR squash -> publish. Require all thirteen hosted jobs, fifteen source-pinned original archives, both complete local/hosted ten-gate results and full checksum manifests. All existing resource, source, history, need, comparison and exact-protection guards remain required. Native typed activation deferral and actual explicit retry completion plus four responsive views are required in hosted and recovery evidence. Deferral is not completion and fixture acceptance is not owner live acceptance.

The Front Office workflow guard also requires both one-QB/K/DEF and Superflex journeys on the exact candidate/tree, four responsive layouts, the existing authenticated editable need handoff, exact temporary player/pick protections, actual nonempty outgoing pools and returned packages, independent prepared comparison effects, and history/reload/replace/scope-reset evidence. It accepts the evaluator's truthful verdict; a zero-qualified search is not substituted for protection evidence and no favorable recommendation is fabricated.

The finalized plan pins candidate, tree, source branch, PR, version, unused tag, prior immutable release, draft ID, original run/artifact identities and recovery/prior archive hashes. The Actions prepare phase reads every attachment back before application merge; publish requires that approved PR merged at main with the identical validated tree and verifies immutable release/production identity. Preserve failed and incomplete attempts distinctly. Canonical validation steps must exactly match the application candidate. No Cloud asset-upload credential, new authentication path or application/memory policy change.

Recovery preserves every local canonical manifest payload. The comparison proof comes from the already-required, source/checksum-verified `trade-resource-original.zip` at `browser/offer-comparison/`; its native guard result is required before Recovery is admitted and is retained in `VALIDATION.json`. A redundant copy of those same hosted comparison captures is omitted only from Recovery to keep the existing 100 MiB limit. The original archive, source/semantic predicates, remaining Recovery guards, fifteen native originals and twenty-three attachment population remain required and unchanged.
